subject: Game Theory
title: Constitutional Design
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Constitutional Design.

hook.text: A constitution is a set of rules written before the game begins. It shapes every political move that follows.

buildup.text: Designers must anticipate strategic behavior: how will future politicians exploit loopholes or bend rules?

discovery.text: Behind the 'veil of ignorance'—not knowing your future position—people design fairer institutions.

twist.text: But constitution-makers aren't ignorant. They often design rules that favor their current position.

climax.text: Amendability is key: too rigid and society can't adapt; too flexible and leaders rewrite rules at will.

quiz.question: What does the 'veil of ignorance' help achieve?
